name: Internal Meeting Notes Summarizer
description: Summarizes meeting transcripts for internal staff. Only public or internal-classified transcripts are used; no personal, health, or financial data is processed. A human owner reviews every summary before it is shared.
documentation: Transcripts are stored in the company wiki and sent to a documented vendor LLM under an approved data processing agreement. No personal data is collected. Transcripts are deleted after 90 days on a documented retention schedule. Every request is written to an audit log retained for one year. Users are told that summaries are AI-generated and a human owner approves each summary before it is shared.
